requirements.desc: The CLI must not add or register a `flow status` alias; `sdd-forge flow get status` must continue to dispatch through the existing status command.
requirements.note: R2: keeps flow get status as the canonical status command

requirements.desc: `sdd-forge flow status` must exit non-zero and write a correction that includes `sdd-forge flow get status`.
requirements.note: R3: rejects flow status and points to flow get status
